playlist_id=143
pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)

song_ids=[s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs',[])]
print('song_ids',song_ids)

songs=[]
for sid in song_ids:
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    songs.append(info)
    print('song',sid,info['title'],'play_count',info.get('play_count'))

# Determine most listened (max play_count). If tie, first encountered max in songs list.
max_play=max(s.get('play_count',0) for s in songs)
print('max_play',max_play)
candidates=[s for s in songs if s.get('play_count',0)==max_play]
print('candidates',[(s['song_id'],s['title'],s.get('play_count')) for s in candidates])

# Tie-breaker: first in original order of song_ids
order_index={sid:i for i,sid in enumerate(song_ids)}
best=min(candidates, key=lambda s: order_index.get(s['song_id'],1e9))
print('best_song',best['song_id'],best['title'],'play_count',best.get('play_count'))

best_song_id=best['song_id']
res=apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=access_token, song_id=best_song_id)
print('play_music_res',res)
